name: Stop failed Destiny loop
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca 'podman stop -t 15 upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true; podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}"'
description: Stop Destiny’s failing Upload Assistant restart loop while preserving all mounted data.
